feature_title: Enterprise E-commerce Payment Gateway Integration (Stripe / VNPAY)
root_objective: Ensure zero duplicate charges, graceful network fault tolerance, and secure 3DS authorization.

scenarios.name: Standard Credit Card Checkout with Valid CVV
scenarios.expected: Order status 'PAID', receipt confirmation rendered, DB balance updated

scenarios.name: Concurrent Rapid Double-Click on Pay Button
steps: Dispatch two click events simultaneously within 50ms window
scenarios.expected: Idempotency key prevents secondary charge; exactly 1 charge request processed

scenarios.name: Session / Auth Token Expiration During 3D-Secure Modal Redirect
scenarios.expected: User is prompted for silent refresh; cart state and transaction intent are preserved

scenarios.name: Backend 504 Gateway Timeout Mid-Transaction
steps: Mock payment gateway POST endpoint to delay 30s and return HTTP 504
scenarios.expected: Checkout UI renders retry banner with polling status; order is marked PENDING_VERIFICATION

scenarios.name: Insufficient Funds Webhook Drop Simulation
steps: Trigger card decline webhook with dropped network packet
scenarios.expected: Client-side fallback query identifies decline; user receives actionable card switch guidance
